crossRefs.note: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next…
Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened, and heard, and a book of memory was written…
The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I…
However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example…
that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship…
You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of…
For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when…
I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you…
For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow…
You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of…
and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

translations.web: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.
translations.bsb: Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me.
translations.kjv: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
translations.asv: Come, and hear, all ye that fear God, And I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
